perSection.name: Labels & registry honesty (born empty · fail-closed admission · TEST fixtures · per-instance identity · CBDC NOT_CONNECTED · no telemetry)
Happy path — spec §14.4 12 steps under ALT-4: gross 10000.000000 TEST-USDC-X → fee 10.000000 → net 9990.000000 → issued 4995.000000 @ quote 2.000000
Duplicates & replays — request-id replay · same idempotency key · duplicate payment txId (never a second execution)
Delayed finality — settlement finality arrives after the 15-min quote expiry → EXPIRED_QUOTE, NO mint, held-or-refunded (spec §6.3)
Failed payment — settlement status FAILED: never mints, taxonomy recorded, refund queued
Reversals — pre-issuance → CANCELLED (no mint); post-issuance → RECONCILIATION_BREAK + SUSPENDED; recovery ONLY via the explicit authorized remediation path (INV-D)
Authorization (INV-A / ALT-4) — no program ⇒ refusal · revoked mid-flight · attestation MISSING/STALE/MISMATCH ⇒ suspended · authorized resumption
Invalid instrument/payment — unregistered · wrong network · RETIRED · SUSPENDED · bad auth tag · amount mismatch · jurisdiction · depeg · finality-evidence gap
Supply controls — per-transaction cap · tranche cap · global max supply: each fail-closed (SUPPLY_CAP_EXCEEDED), no partial mint
Three-book reconciliation — C1–C4 clean after the run; a forced 1-micro ledger break is DETECTED (reconciliation is a REAL check)
SEP-01 separation invariant — basket snapshot BYTE-IDENTICAL before/after issuance volume + SOURCE-SCAN test-of-absence
Ledger & persistence — exact flat Prisma IssuanceEvent field set · in-memory sink collects ALL events · failing sink DISCLOSED, cursor not advanced, retry byte-stable
CBDC adapter honesty — SIMULATED / NOT CONNECTED · every simulated message labeled · ONE clearly-labeled SIMULATION-MODE demo issuance
Constituency quiescence — genesis 7 at STRATEGIC_PRIOR bp · zero transitions ever · empty-directive lifecycle run · weights match the separation snapshot
Final machine-level invariant sweep — INV-A..INV-E across ALL scenario machines + full-run doc-format re-check
